name: Városföld (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow green stripe along the top edge and a row of red triangles rising from the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Városföld: a shield of red and green with a white dragon and three houses.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: row of triangles along the bottom edge
